question.text: For a discretionary portfolio manager, performance indicators in the DD must be calculated using:

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI requires that discretionary portfolio manager performance indicators in the Disclosure Document be calculated using the Time-Weighted Rate of Return (TWRR) method, which neutralises the effect of client cash flows on reported manager performance. The Trap: A simple average ignores compounding and cash-flow timing. IRR (XIRR) is appropriate for investor-specific reporting because it reflects cash-flow timing, but it is not the SEBI-mandated metric for the DD. Holding period return alone does not annualise consistently across periods. Note: Distributor-style pro-tip and cross-exam framing removed; explanation grounded in p.105 (TWRR mandate) with pp.119 and 141 supporting the TWRR/XIRR distinction.
